# Work Lifecycle Roadmap

<!-- Generated by repo-harness-builder; source: core/docs:3.0 -->

<!-- doc-role:lifecycle-owner -->

This roadmap is the canonical lifecycle owner. Track only non-trivial work with immutable `RH-W-####` IDs. Each record keeps origin, justified `P0` to `P3` priority, dependencies, status, completed and remaining work, additions, exclusions, deferrals, rejections, evidence, decision history, and an observable next advancement condition.

## Lifecycle Rules
<!-- doc-role:lifecycle-rules -->

- Status is one of `proposed`, `ready`, `active`, `blocked`, `deferred`, `completed`, `excluded`, or `rejected`.
- `blocked` names its blocker, `deferred` names its advancement condition, and terminal records use remaining work `none`.
- `excluded` is reconsiderable outside current scope. `rejected` is intentionally declined until an explicit later decision supersedes it.
- Update this owner, current-state projection, localized peers, and Engram topic `work/RH-W-####` in the same work unit when reality changes.

## Recreation Method

`wk-skill-forge` is recreated from its first version, one stage at a time. The owner says which stage to work on; never continue into the next stage on your own.

The original lives in `<original-repo>`, a local clone of the original repository, as `0_skill/mis_skills/wk-skill-forge-ld9/` (renamed here to `wk-skill-forge`). Read a stage's commits there, read-only:

```
git -C <original-repo> show --stat <hash>
git -C <original-repo> show <hash> -- 0_skill/mis_skills/wk-skill-forge-ld9 tests
```

Recreate the intent, not a blind copy. Replace every `wk-skill-forge-ld9` with `wk-skill-forge`. Improvements over the original are welcome when the owner agrees.

Per stage:

1. Read the stage's commits in the original.
2. Recreate the change in `wk-skill-forge/`, with its tests.
3. Run the tests.
4. Commit the stage as one work unit and mark its record `completed` here, with the commit as evidence.

### Reference-only commits

The original folder had 24 commits; the 19 in the records below changed `SKILL.md`. These 5 changed only references (and their tests). Fold each into the stage where it fits, and record the fold in that stage's record when it is decided:

|---|---|

| `ad87065d` | Verified official entry points per topic |
| `b48d2c0d` | Lighter partial intake, real-input test hint, document checks |
| `38110bef` | Drop trailing slash before link checks |
